mentions.name: ZeroQuarry
mentions.description: Security platform that augments small or overloaded security teams. It can run penetration tests and generate pentester-style PDF reports for auditors and procurement, triage incoming emails from security researchers by verifying whether the reported vulnerabilities actually exist and are exploitable, and hook into GitHub to scan for vulnerabilities, auto-propose fixes, or file GitHub issues. Free for open source projects.
mentions.problem: Small and overloaded security teams lack capacity to handle pentesting, security researcher email triage, and vulnerability remediation.
mentions.audience: Security teams using it to augment capacity, auditors and procurement receiving the generated reports, and open source maintainers (free for open source projects).
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building http://zeroquarry.com

It's a way to augment small/overloaded security teams.  It can pentest and then generate a pentester-style PDF report for auditors and procurement, triage incoming e-mails from security researchers by then checking whether the vulnerabilities they claim actually exist and are exploitable, hook into GitHub to scan for vulnerabilities and auto-propose fixes or file GitHub issues for you.
